Name: Stardrips Coffee
Author: ryck215
Description:
[b]**Updated for [/b][b]1.6**[/b]

This mod adds 1 new coffee/espresso drinks and associated cooking recipes to Stardew Valley for Stardrips Coffee, each of which give a buff to your speed, as well as another skill based on which one you drink.


[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5]Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
By default, you start with one recipe to make a Stardrips Cafe Misto.  The remaining 10 recipes are sold by various NPCs around the game.

NPCs Selling Recipes:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Pierre[/*]
[*]Sandy[/*]
[*]Harvey[/*]
[*]Marlon[/*]
[*]Willy[/*]
[*]Dwarf[/*]
[*]Krobus[/*]
[*]Robin[/*]
[*]Alex (Ice Cream Cart)[/*]
[*]Raccoon Wife[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

Each drink provides a set of buffs for a limited time after consuming.

Drink Effects:
[spoiler][list]
[*]Stardrips Cafe Misto: +2 Speed[/*]
[*]Stardrips Cappuccino: +2 Speed, +25 Max Stamina[/*]
[*]Stardrips Caramel Macchiato: +2 Speed, +2 Defense[/*]
[*]Stardrips Chocolate Mocha: +2 Speed, +1 Mining Level[/*]
[*]Stardrips Coconut Milk Latte: +2 Speed, +1 Farming Level[/*]
[*]Stardrips Hazelnut Latte: +2 Speed, +2 Attack[/*]
[*]Stardrips Maple Latte: +2 Speed, +1 Fishing Level[/*]
[*]Stardrips Pumpkin Spice Latte: +2 Speed, +1 Foraging Level[/*]
[*]Stardrips Affogato: +2 Speed, +64 Magnatism[/*]
[*]Stardrips Joja Blak: +3 Speed[/*]
[*]Stardrips Sweet Gem Latte: +2 Speed, +1 Luck Level[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.[/*]
[*]No known mod conflicts [/*]
[*][s]Integrates with Khadija's Recipe Shop - ﻿https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5245[/s] (This mod not updated for 1.6)[/*]
[/list]Any questions or issues, please don't hesitate to reach out.
